content.text: Digital creators in regions with restricted [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-costing-you-2|Why Payment]] processing often face significant obstacles when setting up online stores. Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, leaving many without viable options to accept payments for their digital products. Fortunately, by [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-step-step-13|deploying]] a robust infrastructure using Supabase as your order database, you can establish a fully functional digital store that accepts [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-2|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments seamlessly, bypassing these restrictions entirely.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment systems are often unreliable in regions facing economic or regulatory challenges. By utilizing a decentralized approach with Supabase as your order database, you maintain complete control over your infrastructure. This architecture empowers you to process payments in cryptocurrency, effectively bypassing the limitations imposed by conventional platforms. Unlike Stripe or PayPal, you own your data and your processes, ensuring that your digital store operates smoothly, even in uncertain environments.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store infrastructure, gather the necessary tools. You'll need access to GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Ensure that you have a Supabase account set up for your order database. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, as this will guide you through the deployment of Stack 01 within 4-6 hours. Equip yourself with digital products ready for sale, including ebooks, courses, or software.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your backend using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. Create a Supabase database to store your order information, ensuring that you structure it to capture essential customer and transaction details. Next, configure NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, linking it with your order database for seamless payment verification. Set up automated file delivery using Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, ensuring that customers receive their products immediately upon successful payment.
Own your infrastructure and data with no dependencies on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After configuring your infrastructure, it’s time to go live. Test your setup thoroughly in a controlled environment to ensure that all components work seamlessly together. Once confident, promote your store to your audience. Drive traffic through social media channels, and watch for your first transaction. When a payment is processed through NOWPayments, the order details should auto-populate in your Supabase database, confirming that your infrastructure is functioning as intended.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is operational, consider scaling. Leverage Supabase's capabilities to expand your database as you add more products. Use the insights gained from initial transactions to optimize your sales process, ensuring a smooth experience for your customers. If you require additional features, consider transitioning to Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, which offers enhanced capabilities and configurations, allowing you to manage a growing digital product library efficiently.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Deploying Stack 01 takes only 4-6 hours, giving you a fast path to market.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
